title: Waterfalls to Whistler Private Tour One Way
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Why just get a ride to Whistler (or Whistler to Vancouver) when you can make the journey the highlight of your trip?
This is a private, guided adventure along BC's iconic Sea to Sky Highway, one of the most scenic drives in the world. Unlike a standard shuttle, you'll have a local guide (me) showing you the best of this incredible corridor, from thundering waterfalls and old-growth forests to coastal viewpoints and hidden local gems.
I have highlighted stops we will visit, but your trip is fully customizable. Want to see something specific or go off the beaten path? We'll make it happen.
All main stops are on short, accessible trails just minutes from the highway, with options for more adventurous hikes if your group is up for it. The tour typically runs 3–4 hours, but I'm not watching the clock, if we're having a great time, we keep going.
This isn't a packed bus with a fixed schedule. It's your trip, your pace. A round-trip option starting and ending in Vancouver is also available.
